# e2b_sandbox_logs (Data Source)

Reads structured logs from a running E2B sandbox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_sandbox_logs" "recent" {
  sandbox_id = "sbx_123"
  limit      = 100
  direction  = "backward"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox ID.

### Optional

- `cursor` (Number) Optional starting log timestamp in milliseconds.
- `direction` (String) Optional log direction: `forward` or `backward`.
- `level` (String) Optional minimum log level.
- `limit` (Number) Optional maximum number of logs to return, up to 1000.
- `search` (String) Optional case-sensitive message substring search.

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Attributes List) Structured sandbox logs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `fields` (Map of String) Structured log fields.
- `level` (String) Log level.
- `message` (String) Log message.
- `timestamp` (String) Log timestamp.
